subject: Close Journey Playbook & week-by-week evaluation — draft GDoc
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@tidalhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Close Journey Playbook & week-by-week evaluation — draft GDoc

Olivia — thanks again for the time today. As promised, I put together a skeleton "Close Journey Playbook" that ties the MAP-style commitments to a concrete week-by-week evaluation cadence. The goal is to make the pilot measurable and the path to a production decision clear.

High-level contents (in the GDoc):
- Week 0: Access + smoke test (data swap, sample inference, perf knobs)
- Week 1–2: Feature validation & latency acceptance tests
- Week 3–4: Scale test + cost/per-token profile review
- Decision gates and acceptance criteria for each week

What I need from you this week:
1) Confirmation of stakeholders for the acceptance reviews (technical, security, lines of business)
2) Any hard constraints on data movement or IP flow we should add to the playbook

I attached the draft GDoc and a one-page checklist. Please comment directly in the doc — I invited your account (olivia@tidalhealth.com) with edit access.

Attachments: engagement-sprint-playbook-v1.gdoc (Google Doc link), week-by-week-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to aligning on next steps.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0191

---
Note: GDoc link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1X-playbook-draft (view/edit)

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@tidalhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Close Journey Playbook & week-by-week evaluation — draft GDoc

Sean — thanks for the rapid turnaround and for putting this into a clear cadence. I skimmed the doc and left a few inline comments about our compliance checkpoints. A couple quick notes: 

- Procurement will need the cost profile split by model variant (we have two candidate models to test). I copied procurement for follow-up.
- Security: we cannot share raw PII off our VPC during week 0. We can provide a synthetic dataset and an in-VPC inference lane.
- Stakeholders: myself (product), Dr. Amir Patel (ML lead), and Brenda Cho (security), plus procurement.

I tried to comment in the doc but ran into a permissions prompt — can you double-check invite? Also attaching a short procurement checklist they requested.

Olivia
Olivia Barnes
Senior Product Manager, Data & ML | Tidal Health
olivia@tidalhealth.com

Attachment: tidal-procurement-checklist.pdf (procurement checklist, 2 pages)

Olivia / procurement — thanks for the quick response and the checklist, Olivia. I fixed the GDoc permissions (you should now have edit/comment access at olivia@tidalhealth.com). Apologies for that slip.

Quick updates in response to your notes:
- Security constraint: switched week 0 to synthetic-only and added an optional in-VPC lane in a subsection ("Data handling constraints").
- Cost breakdown: Marissa has added a per-variant cost table (linked in the doc) and Ben has sketched an example of token-cost sensitivity for the two models.
- Stakeholder roster updated in the header.

Next proposed steps:
1) Olivia: confirm stakeholders & any additional acceptance criteria by EOD Monday (1/25)
2) Redwood: prepare a short 30-min technical onboarding (demo + VPC runbook) for Week 0 — proposed slot Wed 1/27 morning PT
3) Procurement: we can run an initial rate-card/term summary if you share the standard PO language or any non-negotiables

Attachments updated: engagement-sprint-playbook-v1.gdoc (now with comments), week-by-week-checklist.xlsx, tidal-procurement-checklist.pdf (from Olivia)

—Sean
